# sprint topic output

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../README.md) · [Parent](../topic.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint topic output — Understand JSON results, pagination, stderr and exit codes.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint topic output [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Understand JSON results, pagination, stderr and exit codes.

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues list --project PROJECT_ID --limit 1 --non-interactive

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  No command-specific flags.

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output text on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  No existing Sprint session required. Business login/public commands still require an explicit server origin.

NOTES
  Business commands return JSON on stdout; --help, --llms and --version return text (scoped --llms returns JSON). MCP uses stdio JSON-RPC.
  Errors are JSON on stderr with a nonzero exit code. Do not parse help prose as an API response.
  Paginated resources return records and meta. Use --limit to bound results; --all only where command help advertises it.
  No --format flag exists: business output is already JSON.
  Exit codes: {"usage":64,"auth":4,"forbidden":8,"notfound":5,"conflict":9,"rate":6,"upstream":7,"timeout":10}
  --wait observes the accepted job only; timeout defaults to 30 seconds (1..3600). Timeout exit10 or Ctrl-C exit130 preserves jobId/localCommitted; the accepted change continues. No mutation retries.

SEE ALSO
  sprint help topic
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/topic/output.md
```
